reading.title: Reading a Technical Sketch
reading.text: An apprentice looks at a simple technical sketch with a straight line, a curve, and a zigzag path. The trainer points out a right angle and shows how parallel lines stay apart while perpendicular lines meet at ninety degrees. A prism and a hemisphere appear in a separate diagram. The apprentice uses the labels to compare each feature.

reading.title: Measuring a Room Plan
reading.text: An interior designer checks a room plan before ordering materials. She measures the area and perimeter, then reviews the radius and diameter of a round table. A diagonal line helps position the furniture, while symmetry keeps the layout balanced. She also checks a repeating floor pattern so the tiles continue neatly across the room.

reading.title: Building a Repeating Layout
reading.text: A graphic designer arranges small icons in a grid for a wall display. The icons form a regular array, and the working file stores their positions in a simple matrix. Another section uses a mosaic made from repeated shapes. For inspiration, the designer also studies a kaleidoscope pattern with strong symmetry and repetition.
